label: Figure 7.6: Producer surplus in the market for vinyl records
alt: Demand and supply for vinyl records with consumer surplus shaded above the $12 price and producer surplus shaded below it and above the supply curve.
caption: Producer surplus is the shaded triangle below the $12 equilibrium price and above the supply curve (points c, d and b): the amount by which the price received exceeds the minimum sellers would accept. Consumer surplus is shown above it for comparison.
